ideas.title: Following the Money in the Feeding Our Future Fraud Scheme
ideas.description: This story would investigate the financial transactions related to the Feeding Our Future fraud scheme, including the use of shell companies and fake meal programs.
questions: How did the perpetrators of the scheme use shell companies to launder the stolen funds?
What role did fake meal programs play in the scheme?
ideas.insight: By following the money, we can identify potential accomplices and uncover the full extent of the scheme. This story has the potential to expose a large-scale fraud scheme and to hold those responsible accountable.
